Social media sentiment varies by platform, with Zhihu 100% neutral (reflecting educated elite analysis), Bilibili 61% neutral and 39% supportive (Gen-Z attitudes), and Weibo 67% supportive but data reliability questioned due to an unrelated laptop review. Persistent disagreements remain over whether the neutral-to-supportive social media distribution genuinely represents public emotion or is inflated by platform biases and cultural norms, and whether the model is a true 'leapfrog' or still significantly behind due to absence of performance benchmarks. Overall confidence is moderate due to strong verified facts about source distribution and platform stances, but significant data gaps on performance benchmarks and non-English-speaking regions weaken the synthesis.
